title: Weekly digest (4 of 4): a news post in What's next in the app
question: A church news post in the digest shows on What's next only to people who can see the post, and tapping it opens the post. Each sketch is What's next on a phone, light and dark, with the food pantry post added. Pick how a post shows. My recommendation: A. It keeps one kind of card for everything you highlight, as the email does, with 'Church news · Monday 7 December' saying what it is and 'Read the post' saying where it goes.

options.label: A: The same card as events
options.thesis: In the week it was added to, in your order: the post's picture, 'Church news · Monday 7 December', its title (or your rewording), the words, and Read the post.
materials: posted date in place of a when line
options.viewport: This week: Not on callout, the food pantry card, then Baptisms.
options.risk: A post and an event look alike apart from the small line above the title.

options.label: B: Its own section after the weeks
options.thesis: Posts gather under 'From church news' after the dated things, as rows with the picture at the side (as Church news lists them), whatever order you gave them.
options.viewport: This week's events first; From church news at the end with two rows.
options.risk: Ignores the order you set: a post you want first can't be first.

options.label: C: A bulletin item, as posts look
options.thesis: In your order, drawn like the start of a post: a navy rule, the date block (7 DEC) beside the title, the first words and Read the post; no picture.
options.viewport: This week: Not on callout, the food pantry as a bulletin item, then Baptisms.
options.risk: No picture, so a post looks quieter than the events around it.
